outputs.en-US: Editable source ledger, story beats, producer notes and a local review page.
outputs.zh-CN: 可编辑来源账本、故事节拍、制作说明与本地审阅页面。

outputs.en-US: An MP4 generated and downloaded in your own Google notebook. Local scripts prepare and check files; they do not render the video.
outputs.zh-CN: 在自己的 Google 笔记本中生成并下载 MP4；本地脚本负责准备和检查文件，不负责渲染视频。

inputs.en-US: Materials you are allowed to upload, a focus question and an audience.
inputs.zh-CN: 拥有上传权限的资料、视频核心问题与目标受众。

inputs.en-US: Preferred language and visual direction. Every story beat links to a source extract.
inputs.zh-CN: 期望语言与视觉方向；每个故事节拍关联来源摘录。

dependencies.en-US: Node.js 22+ for local preparation; ffprobe is optional for file checks.
dependencies.zh-CN: 本地准备需要 Node.js 22+；文件检查可选用 ffprobe。

dependencies.en-US: A signed-in Google Gemini Notebook (NotebookLM) account, internet access and available Video Overview quota. Browser automation is optional; manual handoff works too.
dependencies.zh-CN: 已登录的 Google Gemini Notebook（NotebookLM）账号、网络与可用视频概览额度；可使用浏览器自动化，也可手动交接。

fit.en-US: For educators, researchers and creators who need a traceable path from source material to an explainer.
fit.zh-CN: 适合希望从资料到说明视频都有来源可追溯的教育者、研究者与内容创作者。

limits.en-US: Independent SiSkill workflow, not a Google product. Google fees and quotas are separate. Format, language and advanced options depend on your account. Native videos may contain generated narration; review facts and audio. Exact duration, shots and resolution are not guaranteed. The store demo is silent and includes labeled workflow illustrations.
limits.zh-CN: SiSkill 独立工作流，非 Google 官方产品。Google 费用和额度另计；格式、语言及高级选项取决于账号。原生视频可能含生成配音，需核对事实与声音；不保证精确时长、镜头和分辨率。商店演示为静音，工作流示意会明确标注。

title.zh-CN: 真实生成片段 · 静音

description.en-US: 12 seconds from a real 6:37 Google-generated explainer using our original fictional source. Narration removed. The service chose its own visual treatment.
description.zh-CN: 原创虚构资料在 Google 中真实生成的 6 分 37 秒说明视频，截取其中 12 秒并移除配音；画面风格由服务决定。

outputs.en-US: Complete article and selected platform drafts, a source ledger and revision-bound editorial reviews.
outputs.zh-CN: 完整母稿与指定平台文案、来源账本和绑定稿件版本的编辑审核。

outputs.en-US: A local HTML review page, editable Markdown and JSON, cover/video briefs and an empty retrospective template.
outputs.zh-CN: 本地 HTML 审阅页、可编辑 Markdown 与 JSON、封面／视频制作说明及待填写的复盘模板。

inputs.en-US: Your topic or existing draft, intended reader, owned source materials and selected platforms.
inputs.zh-CN: 你的选题或已有稿件、目标读者、有权使用的资料，以及希望发布的平台。

inputs.en-US: Your own voice preferences and evidence. No private author persona or account configuration is included.
inputs.zh-CN: 自己的表达偏好与事实依据；不附带私人作者语料、人设或账号配置。

dependencies.en-US: Codex or Claude Code with your own model access; Node.js 22+ for the offline handoff helper. No npm dependencies.
dependencies.zh-CN: 自己的 Codex 或 Claude Code 模型服务；离线交接工具需要 Node.js 22+，无 npm 依赖。

dependencies.en-US: Research, media generation and publishing use your own optional tools and accounts. Model and service fees are separate.
dependencies.zh-CN: 资料检索、图片／视频生成及发布按需使用自己的工具和账号，模型与服务费用另计。

fit.en-US: For independent creators and small editorial teams who want a repeatable path from notes to reviewed content.
fit.zh-CN: 适合希望把零散笔记变成可重复生产、可核查内容的独立创作者与小型编辑团队。

limits.en-US: The Agent writes and reviews; the helper validates declared references and revision hashes, not real-world truth. Media deliverables are briefs unless rendered separately. No automatic social publishing, bundled accounts, growth guarantees or included creation credits. The included example is original and fictional.
limits.zh-CN: Agent 负责写作与审核，脚本检查来源结构和版本哈希，不会自动验证现实事实。图片和视频交付默认是制作说明，实际生成另行完成。不包含自动社交发布、账号、涨粉保证或创作额度。附带案例为原创虚构练习。

title.zh-CN: 真实导出的本地审阅页

description.en-US: Generated by the included helper from an Agent-authored fictional example: an English master, an X thread and a Chinese Xiaohongshu note. Reviews are editorial judgments; the content has not been published.
description.zh-CN: 使用附带脚本和 Agent 实际撰写的虚构案例生成：英文母稿、X 线程与中文小红书文案。评分为编辑判断，内容尚未发布。
